request: Q137 (prediction is the goal): the blind test of Q137(m)'s frozen model M6 on blind pool 4; the kinds page's section 11, item 6 ('a power model across kinds')
card: aifoundry3 card 0, 600 MHz as its boot-time TDP of 0 latches it, TDP 0 / threshold 65 C as read, never set

plan.order: Random('E140|aifoundry3|<pass>'): the 25 tiles dealt into three segments of 9, 8, 8, each with E78's six anchors, reshuffled; the tie first and last (E115's order, unchanged)
plan.protocol: E78's: heat to 59 C, launch at 58 C after 2.0 s quiet, 4 s runs, 1,024 minions, 600 MHz
plan.deadline: 2026-11-02 21:40 PST (no session starts after 21:00 PST; every run ends by 21:45 PST)

model.name: M6 (Q137(m)): power = M5's bench terms plus per-flip terms, the form chosen by leave-one-kind-out, constants on all rows; heat = die rise per board W per card over the kinds window, with the time constants of E73/E97 and the steady coefficients of E97/E111/E133
model.units: power: W over the type's own zeros at 600 MHz on aifoundry3 card 0's footing (card 1 x card1_scale); heat: C over the run's launch reading, S = board W over idle
model.heat_window: the kinds harness: a run of T_run s (4.5 s typical) from launch; ST = S x (T_run - 4.5); off = launch reading less the pass's median launch reading

heat_measure.what: E78's per-run die rise over the run's window from its launch reading (reduce_e78.py's dT_win), mean over the tile's kept passes: the quantity M6's heat term predicts (its window, above)

power.measure: D: board W over the type's own zeros interpolated in time (reduce_e78.py), mean over kept passes, aifoundry3 card 0, 600 MHz
power.reference_errors_what: M6's nested leave-one-kind-out error of every power row of that format, both cards (bootstrap-m6.json > row_errors > m6_nested_err_w), as E115's R1/R2 drew M5's

heat.reference_errors_what: no per-row nested heat errors are committed: a deterministic normal sample of 2,000 with M6's nested heat rms of that format (m6.json > heat > interval_pool_c) as its rms

heat.end_to_end_note: heat error when S is predicted: the nested heat error plus the card's S coefficient times the nested power error (rows with both)

E140-P1.what: rms(measured - M6) over the family's priority-1 tiles against the 2.5-97.5% range of the rms of the same format mix drawn from M6's nested leave-one-kind-out errors of those formats (power: every row's, bootstrap-m6.json; heat: a normal sample with the nested rms, m6.json); PASS if at or below the 97.5% point, FAIL above it; NOT SCORED under the family's minimum

E140-P2.what: rms(measured - M6) over the family's priority-1 tiles against the 2.5-97.5% range of the rms of the same format mix drawn from M6's nested leave-one-kind-out errors of those formats (power: every row's, bootstrap-m6.json; heat: a normal sample with the nested rms, m6.json); PASS if at or below the 97.5% point, FAIL above it; NOT SCORED under the family's minimum

E140-P3.what: the share of all tiles whose measured value lies inside M6's frozen 95% interval, against the 2.5% point of Binomial(n, 0.95): PASS at or above it, FAIL below; NOT SCORED under 10 tiles

E140-H1.what: rms(measured - M6) over the family's priority-1 tiles against the 2.5-97.5% range of the rms of the same format mix drawn from M6's nested leave-one-kind-out errors of those formats (power: every row's, bootstrap-m6.json; heat: a normal sample with the nested rms, m6.json); PASS if at or below the 97.5% point, FAIL above it; NOT SCORED under the family's minimum

E140-H2.what: rms(measured - M6) over the family's priority-1 tiles against the 2.5-97.5% range of the rms of the same format mix drawn from M6's nested leave-one-kind-out errors of those formats (power: every row's, bootstrap-m6.json; heat: a normal sample with the nested rms, m6.json); PASS if at or below the 97.5% point, FAIL above it; NOT SCORED under the family's minimum
